acceptanceCriteria: internal/dogfoodflow/change.go fix-hint table has an entry for cem-cite:cite-self-modified-authority naming the recovery (cite a non-modified governing source or keep the hunk unknown)
internal/observations admits cite-self-modified-authority to the self-observation ledger like the other cem-cite codes, with a test
the error-code-ownership check and both package tests pass
body: Observed 2026-10-15 in the V1-0414 closeout lane (PR beamfall/corvint#902, change 1ff0ae458, BASE 495eda08c). That lane added CEM-V1-114: cem cite now refuses a citation of a governing file modified by the same change with the new code cite-self-modified-authority (internal/cem/cemcode/cemcode.go). Two consumers were outside its scope: internal/dogfoodflow/change.go (~:1390) has fix hints for other cem-cite:* codes but none for this one, so dogfood-change prints the bare code; internal/observations/observations.go does not list the new code for the self-observation ledger. Expected: every cem-cite refusal code has a hint and is admitted. Actual: the new code has neither. Inferred from the lane report and the hint table at origin/main; not yet reproduced end to end.
title: cem cite code cite-self-modified-authority (CEM-V1-114) has no dogfood fix hint and is not admitted to the self-observation ledger
